title: From Diffusion to Flow: Efficient Motion Generation in MotionGPT3
abstract: arXiv:2603.26747v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent text-driven motion generation methods span both discrete token-based approaches and continuous-latent formulations. MotionGPT3 exemplifies the latter paradigm, combining a learned continuous motion latent space with a diffusion-based prior for text-conditioned synthesis. While rectified flow objectives have recently demonstrated favorable convergence and inference-time properties relative to diffusion in image and audio generation, it remains unclear whether these advantages transfer cleanly to the motion generation setting. In this work, we conduct a controlled empirical study comparing diffusion and rectified flow objectives within the MotionGPT3 framework. By holding the model architecture, training protocol, and evaluation setup fixed, we isolate the effect of the generative objective on training dynamics, final performance, and inference efficiency. translated_title: 从扩散到流：MotionGPT3中的高效运动生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.26747v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：近期基于文本驱动的运动生成方法涵盖了离散标记方法和连续潜在空间公式。MotionGPT3体现了后一种范式，将学习的连续运动潜在空间与基于扩散的先验相结合，用于文本条件合成。尽管整流流目标最近在图像和音频生成中显示出相对于扩散的更优收敛性和推理时间特性，但尚不清楚这些优势是否能干净地转移到运动生成设置中。在本工作中，我们在MotionGPT3框架内进行了受控实证研究，比较了扩散和整流流目标。通过保持模型架构、训练协议和评估设置不变，我们隔离了生成目标对训练动态、最终性能和推理效率的影响。在HumanML3D数据集上的实验表明，整流流收敛更高效。
tldr: 本研究在MotionGPT3框架中通过受控实验证明，整流流目标相比扩散在运动生成中实现更快的收敛，同时保持模型架构不变，提升了训练和推理效率。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through controlled experiments in the MotionGPT3 framework that rectified flow objectives achieve faster convergence than diffusion in motion generation, while keeping the model architecture fixed, enhancing training and inference efficiency.
